features_meta.layer: BEATs final Transformer encoder layer output (input to the AudioSet predictor head), 768-d per frame
features_meta.pooling: mean over all time frames, padded frames included (no padding_mask; zero padding kept as audio)
features_meta.resampler: windowed-sinc, Blackman window, 16 zero crossings, cutoff min(sr_in, sr_out)/2 (src/eval_common.py:resample)
features_meta.padding: zero padding to 10 s kept as audio; per-clip content_s stored

settings.ci: Wilson 95% and percentile cluster bootstrap over source_group
settings.class_of_clip: human pass-1 label, usable rule of scripts/validate.py:usable_clips
settings.family_hit: any audioset_family node or ontology descendant in top-k
